owns: chain json validation and agent ref resolution
does_not_own: branch routing after an agent emits
watchdog or chain-watcher lifecycle; web/server/background-worker.ts owns both typed services

run_json.add_run_session: promotes run to running and upserts agent session
run_json.startup_failure: marks agent/run failed or blocked without sending instructions

session_contract.agent_session: remove existing session, transport_new_session, send start script
session_contract.monitor_session: monitor-<agent-session>; mon_script inline-exports the full completion context (runner-v2 flags, MENTIKO_RUN_DIR, RUNS_DIR, NAMESPACE_ID, ORG_ID, EVENTS_DIR, STATE_DIR, MENTIKO_CODE_ROOT) because the pty daemon whitelists spawn env (3c0b305)
session_contract.instructions: write artifact instructions file and send short pointer to TUI

readiness.gate: wait_for_profile_readiness (lib/chain-runner.sh) classifying via cli_readiness_check (lib/cli-readiness.sh); must pass before task instructions are sent
readiness.classification_order: blocked_patterns, recoverable_patterns, retry_patterns, ready_patterns; first enabled match wins; text = literal substring (grep -F), regex = case-insensitive ERE (grep -Ei)
readiness.legacy_default: flag off is permissive: readiness disabled, unknown, or no ready_patterns proceeds, so pattern catalogs roll out profile-by-profile without changing behavior
readiness.fail_closed: MENTIKO_READINESS_FAIL_CLOSED=1: disabled policy or zero ready_patterns is no_ready_signal (never inject); unknown keeps polling and blocks at the deadline
readiness.startup_recovery: bounded advisor recovery for blocked/recover/retry (MENTIKO_STARTUP_RECOVERY default on, MENTIKO_STARTUP_RECOVERY_MAX default 2 actions per startup); no_ready_signal escalates immediately (config error the advisor cannot fix)
readiness.terminal_effects: write <agent>-startup-capture.txt + <agent>-startup-readiness.json (+ <agent>-startup-recovery-prompt.txt), mark state file and run agent blocked, send no instructions, leave the session alive
readiness.exited: session with no active command classifies exited; agent/run marked failed (CLI exited before instructions were sent)

session_contract.local_remote_split: local, ssh, and docker launch paths remain distinct

invariants: run.json writers use the shared lock protocol
startup failure must not paste instructions into idle shell
readiness classification is profile-driven data, never hardcoded prompt heuristics (a7956d9, 20ce3b1)
best-effort observability writers (perf/metrics/profiler) must never abort a live run under set -e + ERR trap (23bdfe7)
diagnostic monitor events must not look like successful handoff events
